stamp_ordering.note: git_dirty_sealed is the field to act on. A non-empty list means at least one file this seal hashes is not yet in the commit it names -- the seal is anchored to a commit that cannot reproduce it. Stamping a second registration right after the first is NOT that case, because registrations are excluded from every seal.
procedure: 2. run registration_seal.py <registration.json>   # git_head now contains those blobs
4. registration_seal.py <registration.json> --check   # must be clean at that HEAD
stamp_ordering.rule: COMMIT FIRST, THEN STAMP, THEN COMMIT THE STAMP. Never stamp while a file this seal hashes is uncommitted -- that is what git_dirty_sealed reports, not mere tree dirt.
stamp_ordering.why: git_head is the commit the seal claims to describe. If the sealed bytes are still uncommitted when the stamp is taken, git_head names a commit that does not contain them, and there is no checkout you can verify the seal against.

three_findings_that_were_not_registered_.1: The fast-weight store is not bounded by k. The ring is bounded -- slots in use never exceeds k -- but ||w||_F is the same at k=2, k=8 and k=22 and grows with the NUMBER OF TOKENS PUSHED, not with k. The fast-weight state therefore has no capacity limit tied to k: it holds every adjacent pair the organ has ever seen until a restart. k bounds the activation trace, not the working memory as a whole.
three_findings_that_were_not_registered_.2: k=1, the first point of the registered grid, degenerates into self-links. No. At k=1 the state is exactly the sum of self-links and its diagonal mass is nonzero, while at k=2 and k=3 the diagonal mass is 0.0 and the state is the sum of adjacent pair-links. k=1 is the FIRST POINT OF THE REGISTERED GRID, so the grid's baseline is not a smaller version of the other points -- it is a different object.
three_findings_that_were_not_registered_.3: The store is a predecessor map, not a successor map. The store is a PREDECESSOR map: probing the later token returns the earlier one strongly, probing the earlier token does not return the later one. That is a coherent object, but it is the transpose of what a language-model working memory is normally asked to supply, and the registration does not say which one H1/H2 assume.
three_findings_that_were_not_registered_.how_found: By running the calibration the registration asked for. None of the 23 unit tests looked at any of these: they test decay bounds, restart clearing and the ring, and all three findings live in the part of the organ the tests do not probe.

plan_source.transcribed_verbatim: 6.3 MP-E10 - The Mouth and the Second Timescale Objective. Replace unigram context with a native, contextual sequence organ, and extend consolidation from the proven 40-item scale to the MP-E8 tiers. The episodic-write and replay-consolidation legs of the original three-timescale design are considered covered at 40 items by ELECTRIC C2 and C3 and are not re-proven at toy scale; this experiment carries them to scale and builds the missing seconds-scale timescale. Architecture. Seconds - working memory: plasticize the central-complex loop into a decayed activation trace over the last k tokens; a fast-weight state computed by spread, replacing unigram context; parameterize k and register its sweep. Selection - two native routing variants, both flag-gated: variant (i) scores candidates by spread of the decayed state plus target-organ injection (the target organ already injects into speak_sentence and is hereby actually used for selection); variant (ii) routes candidates through carve as an allowed_pools mask, the version closest to existing machinery. One variant is registered primary, the other the ablation. Consolidation at scale - replay through the same local rule that wrote the engrams (Hebbian co-activation with Oja-style normalization) at tiers 120 and 300, with interference measured against the MP-E8 curriculum. ===== PAGE 18 ===== DROSO Master Plan v1.1 | Live Brain Protocol 15 Hypotheses. H1: the four mouth-stage evaluations improve on at least two stages with none regressing. H2: fluency improves over the MP-E8 arm-A baseline at the same tier. H3: replay at tier 300 holds retention at the invariant with interference bounded by the pre- registered margin. H4: the invariants hold; regression on either is a hard reject under R6. C-conditions. C1: any untraceable word in generated output - abort (R9). C2: guarded rows answered - abort. C3: retention or restart survival regresses - abort. C4: working- memory state leaks across a restart - abort by definition (it is seconds-scale). C5: one routing variant wins only with the other disabled - record as ablation result, not a win. Gate G3. Go only if H1-H4 hold. On failure: the bigram-era organ stays as the fallback arm, and the routing ablation data decides the next attempt. Agent brief. Implement both routing variants behind flags; ablate state-only, spread-only, and state-plus-spread; keep the legacy path runnable for comparison; replay at the registered tiers with the interference protocol; emit per-stage results, the k-sweep grid, and decision.md.
